summary: Marked-bay campus car park backing onto bush, no homes, a car parked.

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind and beside; nearest buildings are university blocks and sheds 9 m or more away, none residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed access road runs to the marked bays; room for a van in the bays or at their end.
drivers.traffic: Low; campus service road with some daytime activity.
drivers.convention: Marked car park with a car already parked; campus use may bring daytime foot traffic.

flags: DEM shows steep ground, mean 10%; best section about 6%
Mapped gates nearby have ways round
sun_shade: Open to sun at the bays with tree shade from the north and west.

best_section.where: Bays at the ring end of the small car park, nearest the access road
